Fox Corporation – The media stock jumped 5% following upgrades to overweight from JPMorgan and Wells Fargo. "On a strategic and revenue synergy basis, we see substantial runway for Fox to apply its advertising scale and expertise to Roku's broad household reach," he wrote.
